description: Two subsets are equivalent modulo the ideal of subsets of S exactly when deleting S from both subsets gives the same set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.principal_eqMod_iff.{u} {α : Type u} (S A B : Set α) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SubsetsModuloSmallSets.EqMod (Order.Ideal.principal S) A B ↔ A \ S = B \ S
